scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:full: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,AGENT" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix backend run agent:python"
scripts.zip:all: npm run zip:frontend && npm run zip:backend
